project.name: Arbitrum docs
project.summary: The Arbitrum documentation portal. MDX pages under content/docs compile on request through Fumadocs on Next.js, and a set of TypeScript scripts generates partials from upstream sources and gates every change in CI. Deployed on Vercel.

nodes.label: Website
nodes.summary: The Next.js App Router routes: the docs pages, the landing page, and the machine-readable outputs (markdown mirrors, llms.txt, link previews, OG images).

nodes.label: Docs pages
nodes.summary: Renders every documentation page from the compiled collection, with the sidebar layout, feedback form and page actions.

nodes.label: Landing page
nodes.summary: The home page, its layout and its OpenGraph image.

nodes.label: Machine-readable outputs
nodes.summary: Serves the markdown mirror of every page, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, link-preview JSON, OG images, the sitemap and robots.txt for crawlers and AI agents.

nodes.label: AI chat request
nodes.summary: The /api/chat route that forwards a chat question to Inkeep and streams the answer back, behind a feature flag and a server-side key.

nodes.label: Content pipeline
nodes.summary: Turns content/ into pages: the two Fumadocs collections, the frontmatter schema, the remark plugins, and the helpers that build the markdown mirrors and link previews.

nodes.label: Collections and schema
nodes.summary: Defines the docs and glossary collections, validates page frontmatter, and exposes the single loader every route reads from.

nodes.label: MDX plugins
nodes.summary: The remark plugins that run on every page: variable placeholders in links, comment stripping, preview text, and the markdown-mirror rewrite of custom components.

nodes.label: Markdown mirrors
nodes.summary: Builds the llms.txt index, the per-page markdown twins and their redirects, the link-preview JSON, and records markdown fetches for analytics.

nodes.label: FAQ data
nodes.summary: Reads the Notion FAQ snapshots in content/faq and shapes them for the troubleshooting pages and JSON-LD.

nodes.label: AI chat bridge
nodes.summary: Validates chat requests, maps Inkeep's answer stream to the UI, and emits chat events to PostHog.

nodes.label: Routing and headers
nodes.summary: The Next config: redirects from every legacy URL, the markdown-twin rewrites, security headers and CORS, plus the proxy that records markdown fetches.

nodes.label: Page components
nodes.summary: Everything rendered inside a page: the MDX component registry, interactive widgets, the AI chat panel, link previews, feedback and the page chrome.

nodes.label: MDX components
nodes.summary: The registry that maps MDX tags to React: Callout, Tabs, Var, Term, Accordion, address links and the link override that adds hover previews.

nodes.label: Interactive widgets
nodes.summary: Client-only widgets loaded on demand: the BoLD edge-challenge visualizer, the node troubleshooting checklist, and the Stylus vending-machine demo.

nodes.label: Search and AI chat
nodes.summary: The Inkeep search box and the AI chat panel UI that talks to the /api/chat route.

nodes.label: Hover previews
nodes.summary: The hover card for glossary terms and the link-preview card fed by the static preview JSON.

nodes.label: Feedback and analytics
nodes.summary: The page feedback form with its rate limits, the PostHog provider, and the 404 tracker.

nodes.label: Content lint
nodes.summary: The ESLint language that parses MDX into the same tree the site compiles, and one rule per Docusaurus habit or MDX shape that would break a page.

nodes.label: Rules
nodes.summary: One file per docs/* rule: unknown components, variables and terms, callout types, links in headings, ESM in pages, and the rest.

nodes.label: Generators and gates
nodes.summary: TypeScript run directly by Node: generators that write partials from upstream sources, checks that gate CI, and the move-doc tool.

nodes.label: Generators and fetchers
nodes.summary: Write the precompile tables, CLI flags page, contract addresses, gas-target and FAQ partials, and Stylus examples; each has a check mode that CI compares against.

nodes.label: Checks
nodes.summary: The offline gates: internal links and anchors, glossary ids, banner variables, client-import boundaries, and the Nitro release check that verifies upstream paths.

nodes.label: Pinned inputs
nodes.summary: The pinned data the generators read: contract addresses, Nitro CLI flags, precompile metadata, Stylus example list, the gas-target snapshot and the master route list.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Node test files beside the scripts and lint rules, plus Playwright browser checks against a production build.

nodes.label: CI and refresh workflows
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions: the gate job and build job on every PR, and the Monday workflows that refresh Nitro pins, precompiles, FAQ snapshots and the gas target.

nodes.label: Project config
nodes.summary: Package manifest, TypeScript, Prettier and SVGO settings, and the pnpm workspace rules for dependency builds.

nodes.label: Agent skills and hooks
nodes.summary: Claude Code and Codex skills checked into the repo: brand SVG diagram tools, video explainer renderer, and the hooks that enforce the pattern guide and optimize SVGs.

nodes.label: Content
nodes.summary: The MDX pages, partials, glossary entries, FAQ snapshots and vars.json that every page is built from. Only its data files appear on the map.

nodes.label: Fumadocs
nodes.summary: The docs framework on Next.js: collections, page tree, layouts and the header DOM the theme CSS depends on. Pinned to exact versions.

nodes.label: Inkeep
nodes.summary: Hosted search and the AI answer engine behind the chat panel.

nodes.label: PostHog
nodes.summary: Analytics: pageviews, page feedback, chat events and markdown-fetch events, production only.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.summary: The Nitro and nitro-contracts repositories the generators read source from, and the contents API the release check verifies paths against.

nodes.label: Notion
nodes.summary: The FAQ database the Monday workflow snapshots into content/faq.

nodes.label: Arbitrum RPC
nodes.summary: Public Arbitrum RPC endpoints the fetch scripts read on-chain data from: the gas target and the BoLD edge-challenge snapshot.

edges.label: gates on every PR
edges.description: ci.yml runs audit, types:check, test, vars:check, references:check, contracts:check, gas-target:check, faq:check, lint, format:check and check-links in one job, then builds in a second.

edges.label: Monday refreshes
edges.description: upstream-refresh.yml, faq-refresh.yml and gas-target-refresh.yml run the fetchers and generators and open a PR.

edges.label: writes partials
edges.description: Generated partials under content/partials and the Stylus by Example pages. Check mode compares instead of writing.

edges.label: reads pages
edges.description: check-links, references-check and vars-check walk content/ offline.

edges.label: FAQ snapshot
edges.description: faq-fetch.ts reads the FAQ database with NOTION_TOKEN.

edges.label: on-chain reads
edges.description: gas-target-fetch.ts reads ArbGasInfo; fetch-edge-challenge-data.ts reads the BoLD challenge state.

edges.label: verify Nitro paths
edges.description: check-nitro-release.ts checks every nitroPathTo* pin and content link against the contents API at the target tag.

edges.label: chat completion
edges.description: The route forwards the question with the server-side INKEEP_API_KEY and streams the answer.

edges.label: llms_file_fetched
edges.description: proxy.ts records a markdown-mirror fetch, production only.

annotations.note: Hand-maintained redirect list, 3.5k lines. Never edit between the AUTO-GENERATED markers; move-doc appends one entry.
The single loader() over the dynamic collections. Never import it from a client component; a test walks every 'use client' module's imports.
A JSX tag not registered here fails lint rule docs/unknown-component. A plain .css import here would add a render-blocking stylesheet to every page.

flows.title: A docs page is served
flows.description: From an MDX file on disk to HTML in the browser.

steps.note: An author edits a page under content/docs with title and description frontmatter.
source.config.ts validates the frontmatter against arbitrumPageSchema; lib/source.ts exposes the page tree.
The remark plugins expand {var:…} placeholders in links, strip comments and capture preview text.
The catch-all route calls page.data.load() on first request and renders the body.
The registry turns Callout, Var, Term and the other tags into React components.

flows.title: A Nitro release bump
flows.description: How a new Nitro tag reaches the pages.

steps.note: nitro-bump.yml, or a maintainer by hand, runs pnpm nitro:check-release --to <tag>.
check-nitro-release.ts verifies every pinned path and content link at the new tag.
The contents API answers for each path.
vars.json gets the new version and image; files with the sync-with-var marker get their hardcoded copies rewritten.
precompiles:generate and cli:generate rebuild the tables from the new tag's source.
The chat panel posts the conversation to /api/chat.
The route checks the request shape and the feature flag.
The bridge forwards it to Inkeep and maps the answer stream.
Inkeep answers from the indexed docs.
Chat events are recorded, production only.
